bundle.shortDescription: IKAZE Ledger — Igisubizo cyuzuye mu micungire y’ubucuruzi
bundle.longDescription: IKAZE Ledger ni porogaramu ikora idakeneye internet (offline-first), igenewe gufasha ubucuruzi bito n’ubuciriritse gucunga amadeni n’abakiriya. Igufasha gukurikirana imyenda y’abakiriya, ubwishyu, ububiko bw’ibicuruzwa, ndetse no gukora raporo z’umwuga, inyemezabwishyu (receipts),delivery note, proforma invoices n'ibindi. IKAZE Ledger ikora neza n’iyo nta internet ihari. Yakozwe na MUD SOFTWARE COMPANY...
